title: Juicy Saudia Masarepa Stir-fry
description: A sweet and juicy whole30-friendly dish featuring white masarepa noodles, prepared with minimal ingredients for a quick weeknight meal.

ingredients.name: White Masarepa Noodles
ingredients.notes: Choose unsweetened varieties for a whole30-friendly option.

ingredients.name: Mixed Vegetables (e.g., bell peppers, carrots)
ingredients.notes: Use whole vegetables to increase nutritional value.

ingredients.name: Sauce Ingredients (unsweetened condensed coconut milk or cashew cream for a dairy-free option)
ingredients.notes: Adjust according to preference and dietary needs.

ingredients.name: Garlic and Ginger
ingredients.amount: 3 cloves garlic, minced; 1 inch ginger, peeled and finely chopped

instructions: Boil the masarepa noodles in water until al dente.
Sautee garlic and ginger in a pan with some oil for about 2 minutes.
Add mixed vegetables to the pan and continue cooking until they are slightly softened, stirring occasionally.
Combine the cooked masarepa noodles with the sautéed vegetables and add the sauce. Cook everything together over medium heat until heated through.
Serve hot as a side dish or main meal.
